title: Aliens took over last night
content: Hi. Around 90% of my dreams are mall world dreams. Ive been here almost every night for the past 30 years. I’m American, and autistic. My dreams are not good. Again, at least 90% of my dreams fall somewhere between anxiety, dread, fear, and full blown panic. It has always been this way. Last year I started having heart palpitations and had to wear a holter monitor for 2 weeks. It recorded supraventricular tachycardia with my worst instance during sleep. Also since I began living w my partner a few years ago, I became aware that I’m having night terrors, because I wake him up at night by crying, yelling, thrashing around, talking in my sleep. I felt those details important to share as to how much these dreams effect me. Last night was especially memorable. I was surprised how many details I remembered. The memories keep rushing in. The setting was same as usual. A massive mall with many levels, tons of people, wandering, an auditorium, high levels of dread and feeling of threat. This time, I was aware aliens had come to take over human society. They were not violent per se, but more so matter of fact, and relatively reasonable. It wasn’t like they were coming up guns blazing, it was more like they were infinitely more powerful than humans, so we had no chance of doing anything other than surrendering. It was like they were the new tenants on a lease, and they were giving us a (short) amount of time to leave, so they could move in. It was just the way it was to be. Except we were not just being pushed out of our homes, we were expected to leave the planet, aka die. They weren’t interested in sharing this world, their plan was to build roots here, and we just weren’t part of that equation. Being a highly advanced society taking over another advanced society, it’d make for an easier transition for them to simply build upon our infrastructure, than have to start over from scratch elsewhere. They immediately embraced American culture, and all the stimulation of mall world. They seemed open to the idea of keeping around a few humans who were particularly entertaining. This dream was filled with more people from my life than ever. People I’ve met in every stage of life from age 5 to now. My family members were all there, and loved ones. I was distraught, while most everyone else just went along as normal. I think they believed we’d be fine and allowed to stay. I knew this wasn’t the case. I spoke to one of the aliens who was in some type of leadership position. They informed me that no, we would not be allowed to stay, and everyone would be killed after a set amount of time. TW: suicide. I decided I was going to take my own life, as I couldn’t bare the terror of being part of human genocide. I didn’t want to find out what that looked like, what that felt like. What would be done to us. I tried to find my loved ones so we could go out together, but each time I spotted them, they were too far away to catch up to. As I watched them walk away, I saw them age rapidly, and realized this may be the influence of the aliens, or even of this mall world place, and the way our life timeline and demise was being controlled. I hate these mall world dreams.
